seo.defaultTitle: Horizon Guides | Guided bushwalks in the Scenic Rim, Queensland
seo.defaultDescription: Small group eco interpreted bushwalks in the Scenic Rim from Boonah, one hour from Brisbane. Day walks May to October, hosted walking weekends and a three day border traverse, guided by Teresa Cause since 2008.

hero.headline: The Scenic Rim, off the track
hero.support: Small group bushwalks led by Teresa Cause, an eco certified guide who reads the country as you walk it. From Boonah, one hour from Brisbane.
hero.alt: A walker on an open ridge among grass trees, looking out across the Scenic Rim

positioning.heading: Walks that rarely feel a footfall
positioning.body: Teresa has been sharing the Scenic Rim with walkers since 2008. Groups are eight to ten at most, the pace leaves time for what's underfoot and overhead, and most routes step off the marked tracks into national park country and private valleys you could not find alone.

features.heading: Interpretation is the point
features.body: Flora, fauna, geology and history come with every walk. These are not races to a destination. The group stays together, stops for the tiny spider and the forest giant, and learns how to bushwalk safely along the way. Walk regularly through a season and you build the skills and confidence for bigger adventures.

features.heading: Eco certified since 2013
features.body: Horizon Guides has held Ecotourism Australia accreditation since 2013 and was named a Green Travel Leader in 2023 for ten years of membership. Guides hold Wilderness First Aid certification and carry emergency equipment including a PLB on every walk. Small groups, a hot cuppa at lunch and a home baked treat are part of the deal.

offers.heading: Six ways to walk with us
offers.intro: Day walks through the season, hosted weekends in Boonah and at the foot of Mt Maroon, a three day border traverse, a navigation course, and private guiding when you want a day made for you.

about.heading: About Horizon Guides
about.intro: Based in Boonah, Horizon Guides provides professional guided bushwalks in the Scenic Rim region of South East Queensland and beyond, and is an accredited tour operator with the national parks services in Queensland, Victoria and Tasmania.
about.story:
Sharing the beauty of wild places with people is the principle aim. Every walk is designed to enhance appreciation of the world through ecology and natural history, to acknowledge and manage risk, to set a level of challenge that is appropriate yet stimulating, to build each walker's bushwalking knowledge and skills, to model minimal impact practice, and to allow the time each place deserves.

Day hikes run locally between April and November each year, with hosted weekends in the Scenic Rim and limited departures of walking holidays interstate. Horizon Guides was featured on Channel 7's The Great South East in 2013 and joined by the Queensland Weekender team on the Mt Cordeaux walk in 2014.

Sustainability is at the heart of Horizon Guides. The vision since 2008 has been to share the richness of the Scenic Rim by walking it, interpreting the landscape and telling its stories. The work was formally recognised in 2013 with Ecotourism Australia accreditation, and in 2023 Green Travel Leader was added for ten years of membership. Horizon Guides belongs to Destination Scenic Rim, the Boonah and District Chamber of Commerce and Outdoors Queensland.

privateGroups.heading: Private guiding and tailor made walks
privateGroups.intro: Around Boonah there are wonderful places to explore nature in the national parks of the Scenic Rim, and the best of them aren't easy to find by yourself, because there are few marked tracks in this wilderness area.
privateGroups.body:
Based on your fitness and recent bushwalking experience, Teresa selects a walk that suits you, your expectations and the conditions on the day. The best time to walk is usually April to October, with June and July particularly fine: chilly mornings and clear days of 18 to 25 degrees. Winter is the time for the peaks of the Fassifern, from less than half a day on Mt Edwards to most of a day on Mt Maroon, or a full and challenging 12 to 14 hours on Mt Barney. Summer can reach 42 degrees, so summer walks head for creeks and rock pools during the heat of the day.

If you want to go bushwalking somewhere special and would like all the arrangements made for you, get in touch to discuss the options. Teresa loves to create trips around individual requirements. The deposit for a private booking is specified in your quote.
